vb_textbox.text: There seem to be two groups of gnomes. The ones that are red or purple will give you a red basket. The ones that are green or brown will give you a yellow basket. At any given time, one of the two groups is giving better advice. Stick with the group that is giving you a good yield. In time, the yield from that group will wane. At this point, you should switch group. Use your intuition to determine the best moment to switch groups to maintain a good yield. 5 mushrooms is about 'par'. If the yield drops below 3, it is probably time to switch groups.
